text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On my day off, while out shopping, I dropped by a bookstore—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Nope, not here either.
Shouldn't that book be in the new non-fiction section...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. The bigger stores are one nearby, and two further out... huh.
Today's pretty much the only day I have all to myself, though—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?!
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I'm looking for "Never Messy Again! The Ultimate Organization Method" and
"Zero Mistakes! The Solid & Precise Accounting Guide".

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Plus "The Secret Acupoints: The Mystery of Acupressure" and
"Ultimate Stamina Recipes: Delicacy Edition"... Those four!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh. Practicality comes first!
And that's precisely what I need right now!
choice_data_list: I can help you look, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Having you with me is like having the strength of a hundred people!
Let's go track them down right away!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... I'm soooo tiiiired...!
I never thought we'd have to hit every single big bookstore in town...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still! Thanks to you, we managed to find all four!
You really saved my bacon!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Here, drink up, Trainer! Don't be shy!
It's my treat for helping me out today!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*gulp*...
Ahh, that hits the spot~~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The sour lime just seeps right into my tired body...
Phew~... This is the taste of victory, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh...
Once I master everything in these four books—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (They'll totally rely on me!)

text_block_list.name: Delusional Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“Haaah... The work and paperwork just keep piling up.
I have to hunt down receipts just to file expenses... Argh, what do I do~?!”

Heh heh heh... Seems you're in quite a pickle!
Fret not, for you can leave it all—

text_block_list.name: Master Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: To Master Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Master Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Secret Art of Organization...
Thousand-Fist Document Sorting Strikeーーー!

text_block_list.name: Delusional Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“I-In just a flash, the complete chaos
of paperwork and receipts has been perfectly sorted...!”

text_block_list.name: Delusional Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“...Guh?! The moment I sat down to take a quick breather,
my eyes, shoulders, and back completely gave out~!”

text_block_list.name: Master Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Have no fear! I have studied the acupoints
and mastered the secret arts of rejuvenation!

text_block_list.name: Master Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Here goes! Life-and-Death Acupoint Stimulation: Ultimate Pressure Point Strike!
Ho-atchaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Delusional Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“A-Amazing...! My blurry vision cleared up,
and the aches in my shoulders and back are gone~~!!”

text_block_list.name: Delusional Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“Uuu, thanks to eating terribly because of my busy schedule,
I've fallen into a state of chronic fatigue~!”

text_block_list.name: Master Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh. Long ago, in pursuit of self-strengthening,
I tirelessly honed my craft seeking the ultimate stamina cuisine...

text_block_list.name: Master Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My frail constitution is a thing of the past! Now, I am health incarnate! The 'Master of Vitality'!
Allow me to serve you my masterpiece: The Explosive Meat Diamond Set Meal!

text_block_list.name: Delusional Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“Whoaaaa!
Strength is surging through my whole body! I feel like I'm turning totally buff~!”

text_block_list.name: Master Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It also strengthens the respiratory system, so no more choking!
Medicine and food share the same origin—leave all your health care to me!

text_block_list.name: Delusional Trainer
text_block_list.text: “Incredible, Tsuyoshi! You're so dependable! Master Tsuyoshi~~!”

text_block_list.name: Master Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
With work and health management both mastered, I have zero weaknesses!
My title as the 'Most Dependable Horsegirl of the Year' is practically set in stone!

text_block_list.name: Master Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... Ahahaha... AHAHAHAAAーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Eheheh... Ehehehehe...♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whuh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looked completely lost in another world, so I waved
my hand in front of her face and called out to her a few times.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine, I'm listening! I can hear you!
choice_data_list: Good. Well, I should probably get going.
Good. Well, I should probably get going.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you so much!
choice_data_list: If you ever need a hand again, just let me know.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, will do~!
Take care~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Need... a hand?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second—
I went into town this morning to find books, looked everywhere, found nothing...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ran into Trainer, and got help finding—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I was the one relying on them completely!
I'm the one who got helped out!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I mean, I literally depended on them all day long, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!
The road to becoming a dependable Master Tsuyoshi is so long...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't give up! By the end of this summer, I'll be a Master—
or at least a 'Novice Master Tsuyoshi'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Savoring the tart flavor filling her mouth,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi reaffirmed her fiery resolve.
